thread:
emma: Spinning up a targeted pre-promote for rwd-v5q-int4 on the knowledge-base-longform cohort. Running 0.8% live + heavy shadow on 3k seeded examples. Seen some small drift on citation accuracy. Posting snapshots and proposed gate changes.

rishi: Numbers please (citations / mrr / latency p95).

emma: Quick A/B (seeded KB longform, n=3k):
```
baseline (v5fp16)     | canary (v5q-int4)
citation_exactness: 94.8% | 92.1% (-2.7pp)
MRR: 0.781             | 0.769 (-1.5%)
halluc_rate: 1.2%      | 1.9% (+0.7pp)
p95 latency: 520ms     | 390ms (better)
throughput: 750 tps    | 930 tps
```

rishi: Regression small but consistent on citation_exactness -> that's our primary SLO for KB longform. Are failures concentrated on footnote formatting or on page-range citations?

emma: Mostly page-range parsing and parenthetical citations; also a small cluster that adds spurious bibliography lines.

adele: eval-bot, can you run the drift classifier and give suggested actions?

eval-bot: ALERT: slice=kb-longform.citations | citation_exactness_delta=-2.7pp (p=0.008) | halluc_delta=+0.7pp | sample_window=45m. Recommendation: block promotion; increase shadow to 10k; run targeted 500-case rerun comparing tokenization/kv states; consider cohort-specific tighter promote thresholds and a temporary traffic-split routing of citation-heavy requests to fp16.

emma: Current rollout config:
```
rollout:
  start_pct: 0.8
  evaluation:
    promote_after: 2h
    global_mrr_drop: -1.0%
    cohort_overrides:
      kb-longform:
        citation_exactness_threshold: -1.0pp
  autofallback:
    enabled: true
    sustained_window: 1h
    sustained_delta: -0.8%
```

rishi: Two ideas: (1) add a tokenization-consistency pre-check for 500 random citation examples (block if mismatch >0.5%), (2) tighten the kb-longform threshold to -0.5pp and add a staged soft-route where detected citation queries are sent to fp16 variant for 2% of them.

adele: infra-bot, can we run a kv_warmup + tokenization sweep on canary nodes? Anecdotally, int4 can underpopulate KV for very long contexts which can hurt citation assembly.

infra-bot: ACK. Scheduling: kv_warmup_ms change 400->1800 on canary pool; tokenization-consistency sweep on 1k examples; spinning 2% split-route to fp16 for queries matching citation regex. ETA 22m.

emma: Plan: pause automatic promote, PR rollout change to tighten cohort threshold to -0.5pp and add the 500-sample pre-check, enable kv_warmup experiment + 2% soft-route for citation hits, and require pre-promote pass on a 1k citation sample (>= -0.5pp) before any increase. If citation_exactness stays <= -1.0pp for 2 consecutive windows (2x30m), trigger autofallback rollback.

rishi: Also add to runbook: "int4 citation sensitivity" with steps: shadow 10k, token-diff log, rerun 500 failing examples with fp16 and recompute citation_exactness, then decide.

adele: If kv_warmup improves citation_exactness by >60% of the gap, we can keep promotion but with the soft-route until full 100% rollout.

emma: Opening PR for rollout and runbook updates. Will post infra sweep results when available. :hourglass: :memo:
